article.title: Smart Data Repository: policy rationale and proposed governance framework

analysis.bottom_line: Ofgem is consulting on a governance framework for a Smart Data Repository to support the MHHS programme.
analysis.summary: Ofgem is consulting on a governance framework for a Smart Data Repository to support the Market-wide Half-Hourly Settlement (MHHS) programme, which will allow third-party access to electricity data under consumer consent.
analysis.why_it_matters: This consultation is part of Ofgem's efforts to enhance the digital infrastructure for energy markets, aligning with the Energy Digitalisation Framework.
analysis.government_smart_data_perspective: The consultation aims to ensure the governance of the Smart Data Repository is legally robust and proportionate, aligning with the Energy Digitalisation Framework.
analysis.smart_data_ai_link: The consultation is related to the intersection of Smart Data and AI, as it involves the creation and management of a repository for electricity data.
